title: Bad nginx deploy
reason: Both blame the nginx 1.28 deploy, but the engineer cites a timeout misconfiguration rather than the 500‑error regression.
root_cause: The nginx:1.28 security update deployed at 2026-10-26 12:54:22 reduced or removed the proxy_read_timeout setting, causing nginx to abort upstream API requests with 'upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream' errors, even though the API responds normally in ~42ms.
truth: The new nginx version 1.28 introduced a regression that causes it to return 500 Internal Server Error for all requests.
